params.name: name
params.description: This will list only institutions in which the appended string appears.

params.name: iso_country_code
params.description: An array of strings that filters institutions in the widget by the specified country code. Acceptable codes include `US`, `CA`, and `MX` (Mexico).

params.name: page
params.description: Results are paginated. Specify current page.

params.name: records_per_page
params.description: This specifies the number of records to be returned on each page. Defaults to `25`. The valid range is from `10` to `1000`. If the value exceeds `1000`, the default value of `25` will be used instead.

params.name: supports_account_identification
params.description: Filter only institutions which support account identification.

params.name: supports_account_statement
params.description: Filter only institutions which support account statements.

params.name: supports_account_verification
params.description: Filter only institutions which support account verification.

params.name: supports_transaction_history
params.description: Filter only institutions which support extended transaction history.
